name: Deal Tadka
ingredients_raw: Water, Pigeon Pea (6.5%), Onion, Cottonseed Oil, Yellow Lentil (2.3%), Bengal Gram (2.3%), Garlic, Black Gram Lentil (2%), Red Lentil (2%), Tomato, Ginger, Salt, Ghee (Clarified Butter) (Milk), Green Chilli, Curry Leaf and Spices (Coriander, Cumin, Chilli, Turmeric, Black Pepper, Mustard, Asafoetida). Allergen Information: Contains Milk, Mustard. For allergen see ingredients in bold. May Contain Soy, Sesame, Celery, Almonds, Cashews, Pistachios, Coconut, Peanuts, Wheat, Gluten, Sulphites.
